a debugger to our application and we add breakpoints to suspend the program execution. Then we step through the code paths and inspect our heap over the different steps. Using the live debugger in production is usually not an option as we have limited access to the machine and we cannot interrupt the execution of the application as it handles a business-critical workload.How To Debugging Node.jsReading Time1 min readContributeEdit this pageTable of ContentsHow To
